articles.title: Clarametyx Biosciences Announces Positive Topline Data From Phase 2a Study Evaluating CMTX-101 in Cystic Fibrosis
articles.mainIdea: Clarametyx Biosciences Announces Positive Topline Data From Phase 2a Study Evaluating CMTX-101 in Cystic Fibrosis
articles.summary: Business Wire: Clarametyx Biosciences Announces Positive Topline Data From Phase 2a Study Evaluating CMTX-101 in Cystic Fibrosis. COLUMBUS, Ohio, January 09, 2026--Clarametyx today announced positive topline data from a Phase 1b/2a trial evaluating its novel antibody therapy, CMTX-101, in cystic fibrosis (CF).
